description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_ErrorHandler class, which provides mechanisms for muting expected PHP errors within the Smarty templating engine by setting custom error handlers.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ErrorHandler
classes.description: Provides static methods to manage custom error handling in Smarty, including muting expected errors inside specific directories.

methods.name: muteExpectedErrors
methods.description: Sets a custom error handler to mute errors occurring within Smarty directories to avoid noisy logs for expected errors.

methods.name: mutingErrorHandler
methods.description: The actual custom error handler that suppresses errors originating inside Smarty directories, optionally passing other errors to the previous error handler.
